mechanism_conclusions: Learned proposal completeness is a strong positive offline mechanism: full-hypothesis root coverage increases from 12/1612 to 156/1612 without weakening the hard verifier.
Exact CSP is not the dominant Stage-0 bottleneck once all retained roots are individually supported: only 2 of 156 fully covered groups are lost at CSP.
Absolute universal retained-root coverage remains low: 1456/1612 groups are still not fully covered at K=16.
Selected K equals the maximum preregistered query budget, so empirical query-budget saturation has not been demonstrated.
Stage-0 is outcome-blind; closed-loop causal utility remains unproven until equivalence16 and progressive lost7.
